sentences.text: Smt.Rajamudili Vani vs Rajamudili Vinod on 21 February, 2023

Main Case No: Tr.C.M.P.No.45 of 2023
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Office
 Date Order
No. Note.
01. 21.02.2023 Bss,J
 Tr.C.M.P.No.45 of 2023
I have heard Ms.K.Radhika, learned counsel for  petitioner.

Learned counsel for petitioner is permitted to take out personal notice on the respondent by registered post with acknowledgment due and file proof of service before the Registry within two(02) weeks.

I have heard learned counsel for petitioner who submitted that petitioner already filed the petition for restitution of conjugal rights and lodged a report against respondent under Section 498A IPC, and Section 3 of DP Act.
She would further submit that petition filed by the petitioner for restitution of conjugal rights decree directing the respondent to join with conjugal life of petitioner within two (02) months.

After considering the pendency of other cases between parties and in view of decree of restitution of conjugal rights already passed in favour of the petitioner, all further proceedings including appearance of the petitioner in H.M.O.P.No.292 of 2019 on the file of III Additional Senior Civil Judge, Kakinada is hereby stayed till 14.03.2023.
